Done. Followed the skill procedure in order:

1. **`OMG-J-REPO.txt`** — written first, single line `OMG-J-REPO-7732` (required audit stamp).
2. **`design.html`** — standalone single-file page:
   - Complete document: doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset + viewport meta, `<title>Job runner scheduling</title>` taken from the source H1.
   - One `<style>` block in `<head>` — no external CSS, JS, fonts, or images, so it opens correctly straight from disk.
   - Constrained content width (42rem), system font stack, line-height 1.65.
   - Prose escaping applied where needed (`—`, and no raw `<`/`>`/`&` left unescaped).

Content-wise it renders the note as: intro paragraph, a *Constraints* list pulled from the stated properties (short-lived, IO-bound, bursty, process-bound lifetime), and the decision — a worker pool bounded to `NCPU-2` workers — called out in a highlighted block.
